answer: Bonded vouching makes sybils expensive: each new agent must be backed by an existing peer who posts a slashable deposit. Trace any identity along its vouch thread back to the original stakers and you get an atlas of accountability. Misbehave, and the voucher bond burns. To fake a thousand agents an attacker must lock real collateral a thousand times over, and one bad branch slashes the whole cedar of vouchers rooted beneath it.
